fields.name: region
fields.description: The region of the server, for example `"EU"`, `"US"` or `"ASIA"`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the server in its region, for example `"I"`, `"II"` or `"PVP"`.

fields.name: pvp
fields.description: `true` on a PvP server (`is_pvp`): a name that starts with `PVP` or `HARDCORE`, and the `TEST` and `DUNGEON` servers (node/server.js:367-418).

fields.name: gameplay
fields.description: The game mode of the server. The server name selects it (node/server.js:367-410).

fields.name: info
fields.description: `instance.info` of the first map. In practice it is always `{}`: the code reads `socket.first_map` before it sets it (node/server.js:4982-4985). The `start` entry lists the forms of `instance.info`.

fields.name: version
fields.description: `G.version`, the version of the game data, for example `17478`.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The start position of the camera: the observer point of the server, or the position of the matched character.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The start position of the camera. The server adds 120 to the observer point. For a matched character it adds 120 only when the query has `desktop` (node/server.js:4987, 5003-5006).

fields.name: map
fields.description: The start map of the camera: the map of the matched character, or the observer map of the server.

fields.name: in
fields.description: The start instance of the camera.

fields.name: S
fields.description: The server event state `E`, the same object as the `server_info` payload. The page "Server events" lists its keys.

fields.name: character
fields.description: Only when the `secret` query parameter matches the secret of a character on this server. A character in a generated map matches only with `map_protocol=1`.

confirm.note: `broadcast_e(true)` only reads E here; it sends nothing.

WelcomeCharacter.summary: The character that a `welcome` observer follows: `player_to_client(player)`, with `id` and `name` set to the name of the character.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the character, the same as `id` (node/server.js:4998).

senders.what: The `connection` handler of the socket. It first sends `map_chunk` events when the start map is a generated map.
